messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most important Texas traffic laws (as of 2024). For the full legal text, see the Texas Transportation Code or the Texas Department of Public Safety website. | Area | Key Points | |------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise signed.
• On highways, 55 mph is the default limit if no sign is posted.
• School zones: 25 mph during school hours (or 20 mph if signs indicate). | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster appropriate for their size/weight.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) over 0.08 % is illegal for all drivers.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, possible jail time, and mandatory alcohol‑education programs. | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Handheld phone use is prohibited for all drivers (unless using hands‑free).
• Violations carry a fine of up to $200 plus points on your driver record. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, yield to vehicles approaching from the right.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights; failure to stop can result in a ticket and points. | | **School Bus Laws** | • When a school bus stops and its stop arm is extended, all traffic must stop until the arm retracts.
• Failure to stop can lead to a fine and points. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 15 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• Parking in handicap spaces without proper signage is a misdemeanor. | | **Vehicle Equipment** | • Headlights must be on between sunset and sunrise, and when visibility is reduced.
• Tires must have adequate tread depth (minimum 2 mm in the tread grooves). | ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Official rules, forms, and updates. 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Full statutory text available online. 3. **Local County Courts** – Check county court websites for local ordinances (e.g., city-specific speed limits). If you’re looking for specific case law or recent court decisions involving Texas traffic statutes, let me know and I can pull up relevant cases for you.
